tasks.label: Flash Pico (RP2040) via OpenOCD/SWD
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -f target/rp2040.cfg -c "program ${workspaceFolder}/build/src/blink.elf verify reset exit"
tasks.detail: For the original Pico. Requires a Debug Probe (official or DIY) wired per docs/07-debugging-swd.md. Swap to interface/linuxgpiod.cfg if using direct Pi GPIO wiring instead.

tasks.label: Flash Pico 2 (RP2350) via OpenOCD/SWD
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -f target/rp2350.cfg -c "program ${workspaceFolder}/build/src/blink.elf verify reset exit"
tasks.detail: For the Pico 2. Requires a Debug Probe (official or DIY) wired per docs/07-debugging-swd.md. Swap to interface/linuxgpiod.cfg if using direct Pi GPIO wiring instead.
